channels.delivery: stored in the Task Scheduler database
channels.limitation: a signal, not a delivery: no one on this host reads it
channels.name: task_scheduler_last_result

channels.limitation: EDGE04_ALERT_WEBHOOK is not set; the code path exists and is tested, but no URL is configured and this session will not invent one
channels.name: webhook

statement: an alert can now reach the person at this machine, and the OS records the receipt. An alert cannot yet leave the machine: no webhook, no mail transport and no event-log permission exist here. Until one of those is enabled, an unattended failure at night is still only recorded, not delivered.
